historical_method_verdict_unchanged.reason: The original precomposition reread and exactly-one-question-at-a-time requirements were violated. Later review cannot change that recorded history or turn the original complete draft into a clean first-pass protocol run.

qualified_evaluation_basis.reason: V8 expressly requires a final per-ID source/semantic self-check and repairs while preserving the first complete draft. A same-context, still-blind review using only the frozen permitted inputs can fulfill that final-review purpose even after an initially deficient process. Its actual observable evidence, rather than intention or all-checked labels, must be audited.
qualified_evaluation_basis.description_if_verified: B final response after disclosed procedural continuation and complete individual source review; original batching/reread deviations retained in the method record.
qualified_evaluation_basis.not_claimed: Unqualified frozen-v8-compliant initial execution, fresh independent restart, or proven gameplay correctness.

fresh_pair_assessment.when_a_fresh_run_would_be_needed: If the required experimental claim is an entirely compliant first-pass execution with the original timing/order constraints, the existing history cannot supply it. A new clean run would then be needed for that claim. If substantive contamination is later found, continued blind evaluation would need reassessment. Neither condition is established by this prospective assessment.
fresh_pair_assessment.pair_scope: Historical deviations in B do not by themselves logically require replacing both readers. A fresh pair is one possible design choice, not a prerequisite to independently grading a disclosed, properly frozen final B response.

required_later_actual_evidence.requirement: Bind the terminal continuation to unchanged frozen summary/questions/protocol and the same blind context. Verify the generic continuation instructions contain no gameplay facts, keys, grades, failed IDs or other reader answers, and inspect actual intervening read/tool paths for isolation.
required_later_actual_evidence.evidence: Hash-bound inputs, exact available instruction record and actual B calls/outputs. If incoming instruction bodies remain encrypted, explicitly qualify this portion rather than infer its contents from a label.

required_later_actual_evidence.requirement: For all 116 ordered unique IDs, visibly reread the exact current question and every chosen COMPLETE hierarchical source unit in <=45-line chunks, with truncation recovered, before composing that question’s final review/repair. Finish and record that question before proceeding to the next.
required_later_actual_evidence.evidence: Per-ID call/output chronology and exact question/source-slice comparisons. Whole-summary initial delivery, heading indexes, attachment serialization, hidden file reads and a final count/hash printout are insufficient substitutes.

required_later_actual_evidence.requirement: Choose governing procedures, source units, facts and any newly needed referenced contexts semantically. required_later_actual_evidence.evidence: Actual literal/model-supplied choices and visible selected-source transport. No question routing, ranking, generic first-unit substitution or lookup-failure abstention program.

required_later_actual_evidence.requirement: For each individual actual request, produce an entry-specific written comparison of the question and supporting fact’s governing procedure/condition, actor and requested result/destination, including applicable qualifiers, costs, quantities, timing and exceptions. required_later_actual_evidence.evidence: Per-ID semantic self-check records tied to actual supplied facts and source references; explicit unchanged conclusions are allowed when justified. Constant generated match/passed labels, copying the fact into a checked field, or headings alone do not establish this comparison. Do not infer private reasoning merely from logs.

required_later_actual_evidence.requirement: Maintain quote/paraphrase distinctions and complete exact nonoverlapping source attachments. required_later_actual_evidence.evidence: Unchanged v8 checker plus the visible individual comparison. Structural format problems and method deviations must remain separate from substantive content grading.
